title: ComSaf Airtight Glass Canister Set of 6 with Lids 17oz Food Storage Jar Round - Storage Container with Clear Preserving Seal Wire Clip Fastening for Kitchen Canning Cereal,Pasta,Sugar,Beans,Spice
description:
About this item
Airtight Food Storage Jar: Glass jars with airtight lid is made of food-graded glass; Each glass container is well sealed, equipped with a silicone gasket and stainless iron locking clamp to make sure your food stay clean, fresh and safe while in storage
Versatile Glass Canisters: The airtight canning jars can be a pickling jars for home and kitchen; It is good to preserve various food like jams, chutneys, flour, cereal, sugar, spices, nuts, tea, dried beans and your favourite snacks like biscuits
Clear Mason Jars: Enhance your kitchen organization with our kitchen jars, featuring a transparent design; the see-through glass allows effortless monitoring of food levels, enabling you to track usage and assess food storage condition
Easy to Fill and Clean: The wide enough mouth and smooth inner wall make the jam jar easier to fill and clean, remaining no food residue on the wall; The design of the salad jars with lids meal prep make them easier to be grasped
Come with Convenient Labels: Except the airtight glass jars, you will also receive labels, they are reusable, you can switch contents whenever you need, Just wipe clean with a damp cloth to change what you have written, Peel and Re-stick

reviews_1s:
I don't do reviews normally, but this one kinda bothered me. I'll start off with the good stuff.
Loved the fast shipping, price and the size and shape. The only issue is that they seem to crack easily. We don't do anything unusual with them. My wife just makes over night oats and places them in the 38 degree fridge. We've had the set less than two months and are down to three now. They seem to keep cracking near the bottom and leaking. After the first one, we thought perhaps they weren't dishwasher safe so we began hand washing them all, but that didn't stop the breaking. I worry that by this time next year, I'll have to buy a new set since they just keep cracking. Perhaps it was just a bad batch, but even at the good price point I'm not sure I could justify this purchase again.Not airtight, they leak. Very disappointed.Glass brokenThe jars were all broken in the box.I’m really bothered that these are literally marketed as safe for food storage when in fact they are not. These very clearly contain lead and storing food in glass containing lead especially for long periods of time is how lead is leached into your food. I’m assuming it’s from using recycled glass but I checked and found nowhere that states these are made from recycled glass. False advertising claiming safety when they aren’t.Click to play video
Very hard to open. Next to impossible to close. A couple of these are easier, but most seem put together crooked with flimsy parts that are likely to break soon.These were exactly what I was looking for but they are way too small. They do not hold 17 Oz like the listing says because I had a bag of dog treats that was 7 oz and not even half fit in these jars. I'm not going to bother returning them.I cut both my hands washing these glass containers prior to use. I was using Lukewarm water and did not realize from the suds that the glass broke. I was very gentle with it too. Now I am afraid to store my food in these containers. Returning these items.Arrived with or ther items that were shattered…. So disappointed!2 out of 3 canisters did not seal adequately. The wire closure mechanism is poorly made and does not hold the lid down snug to the top of the jar.
Dimensions shown on the Amazon website (5 inches wide) are misleading. The jar measures 5 inches between the rounded corners, but only 4.5 inches between the flat sides.
Returned the item.
